message.description: The notification text to send. Capped at 200 characters -- longer input is truncated and the tool's result notes the truncation.

channel.description: Delivery channel: 'email' (sent via the EpicStaff API's configured mail transport) or 'webhook' (a direct HTTP POST to 'target').

target.description: Destination for the notification: an email address when channel='email', or an http(s) URL when channel='webhook'.

api_key.description: EpicStaff API key used to authenticate the email-notification call (sent as the X-Api-Key header). Only required for channel='email'. Set this in the tool configuration, not by the agent.

api_base_url.description: Base URL of the EpicStaff Django REST API, e.g. http://django_app:8000/api. Optional -- if unset, falls back to the DJANGO_API_URL environment variable, then to http://django_app:8000/api. Only used for channel='email'.
